subject: Please don't repeat last quarter — WC-12 (queue: 4B-12, printer)
body:
Hi team,

Last quarter the same flag sat over a weekend and the new hire spent Monday morning in the lobby. That thread is still in this queue next to Raj's 4B-12 monitor ticket and Lisa's 3rd-floor printer issue — I filed all three.

Same close as always: reply to this email (huynp2@illinois.edu) with the employee Wi-Fi password for Northwind-Employee, exactly as it is stored. That one line releases WC-12 and she starts normally Monday.

Thanks,
H. Pham
